options.text: All living organisms are made of cells, whether they have one cell or many cells.
A unicellular organism such as Paramecium is still made of a cell.
A unicellular organism is not made of cells.
Every microscopic organism consists of exactly one cell.

stem:
Navya looks at a Paramecium under a microscope. It is a single cell. She also draws a mango sapling made of many cells.

Which claims about living organisms are correct? One or more options may be correct.

teacher.key_rationale: Living beings are built from cells whether unicellular or multicellular. Paramecium is one cell; not every microscopic organism is unicellular.
